confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge, not from live listings, menus or booking pages. Restaurant and beer anchors are the firmest. Cocktail and wine_glass follow the local beer price relationship because direct knowledge of drink prices is weaker. Hostel and hotel rates vary widely by district and season and are the least certain. Remembered prices were carried forward to July 2026 with modest local inflation and an approximate exchange-rate assumption. The FX value came from search results citing the RBA exchange-rates page and was not cross-checked against a second RBA page.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single direct comparator. Lima is placed among South American capitals with strong tourism demand, below Santiago and at or above Bogota and Quito, with Miraflores, Barranco and San Isidro setting the mid-range restaurant and hotel levels. Cocktail and wine_glass are set relative to the beer anchor.
